_format.name: idioms
_format.description: Idiom with meaning, example, register, topic and a use-with-care note.
notes: Stored in phrases with kind = "idiom". caution = optional note for informal idioms.

items.meaning: something that has both advantages and disadvantages
items.example: Social media is a double-edged sword: it connects people but can also spread misinformation.

items.meaning: a small, visible part of a much larger problem
items.example: The reported cases of plastic pollution are only the tip of the iceberg.
